capability.purpose: Challenge a change independently across requirement fidelity, engineering quality, and verification evidence.

inputs.name: change_set
inputs.description: Non-empty diff, commits, or artifact change to review.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Source specification, issue, acceptance criteria, or requested behavior.

inputs.name: verification_claims
inputs.description: Tests, checks, receipts, or completion claims associated with the change.

outputs.name: review_findings
outputs.description: Findings classified by axis, severity, and supporting evidence.

outputs.name: readiness_verdict
outputs.description: Ready, not ready, or blocked verdict with explicit verification gaps.

preconditions.description: A stable base or comparison point for the change can be established.

requirements.description: Requirement, engineering, and verification axes are evaluated without one standing in for another.
Each blocking claim is tied to inspectable source or execution evidence.
The final verdict distinguishes blocking findings, improvements, and unavailable evidence.

evidence_outputs.name: review_report
evidence_outputs.description: Axis-separated findings with severity and evidence.

evidence_outputs.name: readiness_verdict
evidence_outputs.description: Explicit readiness decision bounded by available verification.

compatibility.notes: Review does not silently repair the change; implementation belongs to a separate capability.
